spec.name: sprint47_volspike_drift_multietf_firerate
spec.hypothesis: After a 1m volume-spike with directional displacement, ETF returns drift in the displacement direction over the hold window, net of T1 costs.
spec.power_argument: 3 symbols x ~0.5 entries/day x ~25 sessions >= 300 validation trades; assumed sd 12bps (verify on train) -> SE ~0.7bps; min detectable net edge ~2.1bps at t>=3; n<300 => verdict 'unpowered' not FAIL; n_train>=100 gate pre-registered.
spec.signal: volspike_drift (factory library; threshold calibrated on train only to fire >=1/day/symbol)
